parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Email, FirstName, LastName, Company, Phone, Title, LeadSource, Status, LastModifiedDate FROM Lead WHERE LastModifiedDate > {{ new Date(Date.now() - 15*60*1000).toISOString() }} LIMIT 200

parameters.query: SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, company, phone, lead_status, external_id, updated_at FROM contacts WHERE updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND (source != 'salesforce' OR source IS NULL)

INSERT INTO contacts (email, first_name, last_name, company, phone, job_title, source, external_id, lead_status) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.first_name }}', '{{ $json.last_name }}', '{{ $json.company }}', '{{ $json.phone }}', '{{ $json.job_title }}', 'salesforce', '{{ $json.external_id }}', '{{ $json.lead_status }}') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, company = EXCLUDED.company, phone = EXCLUDED.phone, external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id, lead_status = EXCLUDED.lead_status, updated_at = NOW()

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ FirstName: $json.FirstName, LastName: $json.LastName, Company: $json.Company, Email: $json.email, Phone: $json.Phone, Status: $json.Status }) }}
